description: This file defines a set of simple methods for payment processing within the OFBiz framework, including setting payment methods, updating addresses, expiring payment group members, and creating PayPal payment methods.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodAddress
methods.description: Sets the payment method address based on the payment method type, handling CREDIT_CARD and EFT_ACCOUNT types.

methods.name: updatePaymentMethodAddress
methods.description: Updates credit card and EFT account addresses associated with a contactMechId, expiring old accounts and creating new ones if valid.

methods.name: expirePaymentGroupMember
methods.description: Expires a payment group member by updating its thruDate to current timestamp.

methods.name: createPayPalPaymentMethod
methods.description: Creates a new PayPal payment method and associated PayPalPaymentMethod record.

methods.name: createPaymentGroupMember
methods.description: Creates a payment group member for outgoing or incoming payments based on PaymentGroup type.
